architecture_summary: Real SQLite delivery, process supervision and callable tool execution exist. Core agent simulation, Phase4 reporting/autonomy, and office stochastic experiments are separate paths. No complete durable owner-objective to validated-artifact and automatic successor flow is connected.
implemented_capabilities: real command and filesystem tool actions
partial_capabilities: task representation is currently delivery events
restart recovery without atomic effect reconciliation
authorization based on supplied identity labels
memory and cycle state outside task authority
artifact persistence without task-bound validation registry
inter-worker reply messages without next-stage handling
baton files without automatic verified dispatch
missing_capabilities: durable automated successor acceptance and dispatch

p0_findings.title: Default worktree setup discards unfinished work
No task validation/completion authority; returned tool failure can become DONE delivery
Crash windows separate reserved key, external effect, audit, reply and acknowledgment
Synchronous execution blocks heartbeats and outlives unrenewed leases

p1_findings.title: Unbound Chief approval labels and prefix-only command policy are insufficient for model-originated execution
Core durable-kernel path lacks acknowledgments and proposal-to-builder/tool connections
No active reasoning adapter or verified capability/baton continuation
Standalone telemetry wiring and freshness do not establish work success
JSON corruption defaults and separate Phase4 state writes weaken recovery

p2_findings.title: Root Python dependency reproducibility and current frontend build evidence incomplete
Full event scans and bounded audit/client buffers limit reporting scale
Bounded Phase4 reporting cycles are not business-work validation

vertical_slice_status.existing: Supervisor, SQLite mail, real tools and evidence/report utilities.
vertical_slice_status.needed: Preserved workspaces, reliable attempts, owner task state, artifact validator, capability/baton dispatcher, truthful projection.

baton_integration_assessment.current: Filesystem handoff documents tracked in Git; no runtime dispatch or verified acceptance.
baton_integration_assessment.proposed: Canonical accepted baton plus task/validation state and unique successor outbox in one SQLite transaction; atomic filesystem export/current pointer as rebuildable projection.
baton_integration_assessment.transaction_limit: SQLite, Git and filesystem effects cannot be claimed as one transaction; reconcile interruptions.
baton_integration_assessment.successor_policy: Capability keys and bounded deterministic policy; no model-selected expensive fallback.

persistence_assessment.interpretation: Durability is implemented for messages, audits and component JSON stores. Live default state is absent; no database created or queried. Business tasks/validation are absent, and effect recovery is not atomic.

autonomy_assessment.swarm: Processes targeted supplied events and emits heartbeats; no owner planner/model/validator.
autonomy_assessment.core: Fixed agent logic and SIMULATE/NOOP safeguard executor.
autonomy_assessment.phase4: Deterministic report/no-op proposals and audit/report writes.

validation_assessment.existing: Tests, certification evidence checks, integrity/inspection and replay.
validation_assessment.missing: Independent persisted per-artifact task acceptance and bounded repair.

test_assessment.method: Reviewed source; no runtime/tests started under the three-output-only audit scope.
test_assessment.ui_build: UNVERIFIED; dependencies absent; Shift 0 recorded no technical reason for omission

recommended_work_packages.title: Preserve workspaces and bind execution authority
recommended_work_packages.objective: Non-destructive worker setup and recorded trusted approval for one bounded action route.
recommended_work_packages.acceptance_test: Repeated setup preserves tracked edits, untracked artifacts and ignored output; forged approval and out-of-scope actions fail; approved bounded action runs.

recommended_work_packages.title: Make execution attempts recoverable
recommended_work_packages.objective: Independent liveness, lease renewal/fencing, recoverable effect/result state, and child-process lifecycle.
recommended_work_packages.acceptance_test: Long action survives heartbeat/lease thresholds; crash boundaries recover one result or explicit uncertainty; failures are distinct from acceptance; caller cannot bypass idempotency.

recommended_work_packages.title: Add one durable owner-task contract
recommended_work_packages.objective: Owner intake, task/attempt ownership and status, conditional transitions, durable bounded retries and transactional dispatch.
recommended_work_packages.acceptance_test: Restart preserves task and attempt; denials/nonzero results cannot pass tasks; duplicate submission or claim cannot create competing accepted attempts; exhausted retries stop.

recommended_work_packages.title: Gate artifacts with persisted validation
recommended_work_packages.objective: Bind output hashes and Git state to independent persisted verdicts and bounded repair.
recommended_work_packages.acceptance_test: Real incorrect output is rejected, repaired output accepted; both verdicts persist; tampering fails; restart resumes pending validation; model success text cannot pass.

recommended_work_packages.title: Connect capability routing and verified batons
recommended_work_packages.objective: One configured adapter behind deterministic capability policy; canonical baton records, outbox, export and successor consumption.
recommended_work_packages.acceptance_test: Accepted stage schedules one successor across duplicate delivery/restart; interrupted export rebuilds; bad evidence/version rejected; unavailable route and unauthorized resource escalation block; fixture and separately authorized real-adapter acceptance remain distinct.

recommended_work_packages.title: Project the verified slice and certify restart
recommended_work_packages.objective: Task/verdict/baton truth and freshness in current UI/API, explicit corrupt-state failure, reproducible acceptance evidence.
recommended_work_packages.acceptance_test: Owner-to-artifact-to-failed-validation-to-repair-to-pass-to-successor flow survives restart; stale UI and corrupt state are explicit; source-bound test/build evidence and repeatable setup recorded.

evidence.finding: Fixed agents and supervisor startup, no model/intake/validator
Real tool-request flow and generic result handling
Heartbeat between synchronous events and unconditional acknowledgment after return
Five infrastructure tables, no task/validation/baton authority
Real effects with separate key, audit and result operations
Existing workspace reset/clean on normal ensure
No durable ack and no builder/tool connection
Audited approval/result dictionary, no tool executor
Mailstore parameter discarded and health independent of state freshness
37 tests inspected against target guarantees; pass evidence inherited
Full audit, per-entity durability, flow, findings and work-package acceptance criteria
